name: Plate Armor
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: One suit of armor and one Shield at a time. Without armor training: Disadvantage on Strength/Dexterity D20 Tests and no spellcasting. A listed Strength requirement reduces Speed by 10 feet unless met; listed Stealth Disadvantage applies while worn.

definition.name: Plate Armor
definition.description: Plate consists of shaped, interlocking metal plates to cover the entire body. A suit of plate includes gauntlets, heavy leather boots, a visored helmet, and thick layers of padding underneath the armor. Buckles and straps distribute the weight over the body.
